//: The project every test file resolves against for linting.
Test files are excluded from each package's build tsconfig so `tsc -b` never
emits them into `dist` - a test in a published bundle is dead weight, and for the
Cloudflare Worker it would be dead weight that gets deployed. The cost of that
exclusion is that the project service cannot find them, so ESLint routes them to
a default project, and a default project pointing at the root solution file
resolves against NO libs at all: `Request`, `Response` and `fetch` become
unresolved types and every call reports 'could not be resolved'.
So there is one file that includes them all. It is wide on purpose - it holds no
source, only test files, and its libs are the union of what the three runtimes
need (Node for scripts, workerd for the Worker, DOM for the app).
